newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds closed lower after recovery based on better than expected U.S. retail sales and producer price data failed to last.
"The figures were reassuring," said one dealer, but he added the market remained nervous and was looking to Thursday's U.S. inflation and industrial production data.
Dealers said the flattening of the yield curve was likely to continue.
One dealer said it was strange that the initial recovery did not hold while the dollar was slipping in late trade. "This should have supported Bunds and guilder-debt," he said.
